item.title: PyPad 1.7.8-prerelease
item.description: - VSCode-like Explorer upgrades: custom chevrons, SVG icons, right-click + shortcuts, shell-menu action. - Workspace opening now persists root and does not auto-open files/dialogs. - In-tab media mode for image/audio/video with controls and Open Raw in Editor. - Detailed changelog: CHANGELOG.md
